description: Generate natural hand-held product imagery from a person image and target product asset.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the product image. The image must be at most 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: targetOriginUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the person or hand pose image.

fields.name: targetMaskUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the black-and-white hand-held area mask. Required because this API accepts custom pose images rather than saved upstream materials.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
